data.name: Depak
data.gender_notes: Depak is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Dipaka' meaning 'Luminous, Illuminating'. In Hindu mythology, Depak is the name of a celestial being and a divine lamp that illuminates the path of righteousness. The name Depak carries the meaning “Luminous, Illuminating” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Depak usually hope their child will grow to embody luminous, illuminating and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of enlightenment and knowledge.
data.etymology: Depak belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Luminous, Illuminating.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Depak total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
